title: 가울테리아 (Gaultheria) - Perenual Protection & Chemical Guide
disease_or_pest_name: 가울테리아 Root Rot, Leaf Spot & Mealybug / Spider Mite Complex
text:
[가울테리아 Indoor Protection Guide]
Pests: Mealybugs, Spider Mites, Root Rot (Pythium/Rhizoctonia)
Symptoms: Yellow drooping leaves, cottony white clusters at leaf axils, fine silk webbing under leaves.
Control: Dab bugs with 70% Isopropyl alcohol. Spray 1-2% Cold-Pressed Neem Oil solution.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Moisture & Substrate Control
treatment_solutions.description: Allow potting mix to dry 50% between waterings. Repot in chunky well-aerated mix.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Organic Remediation
treatment_solutions.description: Spray Neem Oil or Insecticidal Soap every 5 days for 3 cycles.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Systemic Insecticide/Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Imidacloprid granules for severe scale or Fosetyl-Al for root rot.

title: 가지 (Eggplant) - Perenual Protection & Chemical Guide
disease_or_pest_name: 가지 Early Blight, Late Blight & Flea Beetle Infestation
text:
[가지 Disease & Pest Guide]
Pathogen: Alternaria solani & Phytophthora infestans
Symptoms: Concentric brown target-like leaf spots, water-soaked foliage collapse, and flea beetle foliage damage.
Control: Apply Copper Octanoate or Chlorothalonil every 7-10 days. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis for caterpillars.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Cultural Management
treatment_solutions.description: Stake 가지 vines to elevate foliage. Drip irrigate at soil base to keep leaves dry.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Organic / Bio-Pesticide
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Fixed Copper Sprays or Neem Oil extract upon first target-spot detection.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Chemical Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Rotate Azoxystrobin with Mancozeb to prevent fungicide resistance.

title: 감 (Persimmon) - Perenual Protection & Chemical Guide
disease_or_pest_name: 감 Apple Scab, Brown Rot & Fruit Borer Damage
text:
[감 Orchard Care Guide]
Pathogen: Venturia / Monilinia species & Cydia pomonella
Symptoms: Dark corky scabs on fruits/leaves, rapid soft fruit rot with beige spore rings.
Control: Apply Liquid Copper Fungicide at pink bud stage. Hang codling moth traps.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Sanitation & Pruning
treatment_solutions.description: Rake and burn fallen scabby leaves in autumn to eliminate overwintering pseudothecia.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Organic Protection
treatment_solutions.description: Spray Sulfur or Lime-Sulfur before rainy periods in spring.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Systemic Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Captan or Fenbuconazole according to orchard spray calendar.

title: 갓 (Mustard Greens) - Perenual Protection & Chemical Guide
disease_or_pest_name: 갓 Black Rot, Purple Blotch & Cabbage Worm
text:
[갓 Protection Manual]
Pathogen: Xanthomonas campestris & Alternaria porri
Symptoms: V-shaped yellow lesions on leaf margins, blackened veins, and leaf skeletonization by caterpillars.
Control: Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) for worms. Apply Copper Soap for bacterial rot.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Crop Sanitation
treatment_solutions.description: Rotate Allium/Brassica fields for 3 years. Clear all mustard family weeds.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Biological Defense
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma viride to soil at planting.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Bactericide/Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Spray Copper Hydroxide combined with Mancozeb at 7-day intervals.

text:
[꽃양배추 Orchard Care Guide]
Pathogen: Venturia / Monilinia species & Cydia pomonella
Symptoms: Dark corky scabs on fruits/leaves, rapid soft fruit rot with beige spore rings.
Control: Apply Liquid Copper Fungicide at pink bud stage. Hang codling moth traps.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Sanitation & Pruning
treatment_solutions.description: Rake and burn fallen scabby leaves in autumn to eliminate overwintering pseudothecia.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Organic Protection
treatment_solutions.description: Spray Sulfur or Lime-Sulfur before rainy periods in spring.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Systemic Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Captan or Fenbuconazole according to orchard spray calendar.

text:

Pathogen: Alternaria solani & Phytophthora infestans
Symptoms: Concentric brown target-like leaf spots, water-soaked foliage collapse, and flea beetle foliage damage.
Control: Apply Copper Octanoate or Chlorothalonil every 7-10 days. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis for caterpillars.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Cultural Management
treatment_solutions.description: Stake 꽈리고추 vines to elevate foliage. Drip irrigate at soil base to keep leaves dry.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Organic / Bio-Pesticide
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Fixed Copper Sprays or Neem Oil extract upon first target-spot detection.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Chemical Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Rotate Azoxystrobin with Mancozeb to prevent fungicide resistance.

text:
[토마토 Disease & Pest Guide]
Pathogen: Alternaria solani & Phytophthora infestans
Symptoms: Concentric brown target-like leaf spots, water-soaked foliage collapse, and flea beetle foliage damage.
Control: Apply Copper Octanoate or Chlorothalonil every 7-10 days. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis for caterpillars.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Cultural Management
treatment_solutions.description: Stake 토마토 vines to elevate foliage. Drip irrigate at soil base to keep leaves dry.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Organic / Bio-Pesticide
treatment_solutions.description: Apply Fixed Copper Sprays or Neem Oil extract upon first target-spot detection.

treatment_solutions.subtitle: Chemical Fungicide
treatment_solutions.description: Rotate Azoxystrobin with Mancozeb to prevent fungicide resistance.

Control: Spray Potassium Bicarbonate or Sulfur dust early. Treat beetles with pyrethrin soap.

treatment_solutions.description: Trellis vines upright and remove lower senescent yellow leaves.

treatment_solutions.description: Apply Myclobutanil or Tebuconazole during peak humid weather.
